sloka: एषा वै नियतिः श्रेष्ठा याम् गतो हरि यूथपः ।तत् अलम् परितापेन प्राप्त कालम् उपास्यताम् ॥४-२५-११॥
transliteration: eṣā vai niyatiḥ śreṣṭhā yām gato hari yūthapaḥ ।tat alam paritāpena prāpta kālam upāsyatām ॥4-25-11॥

translations.english: 'The state attained by the chief of monkeys is an excellent one.Therefore there is no need to regret. Attend to your duties (relating to rites)'
